author: Lightlyrow
body:
This is my appeal:

Username: Lightlyrow
Reason for ban: Hacking - Aimbot
Why I should be unbanned:
Let me start off. I am guilty. I did use aimbot for a few days until I got banned. Remember, this was nearly 1 year ago. I was banned on December the 6, so it's just over a year. I have changed a lot since then, and do not hack. I understand fully that this makes it not fun for other players, and makes a staff have to work harder at their job, and it should really be unnecessary for them to have to ban hackers. As soon as I got banned I regretted my mistake, so I deleted my hack client (Nodus) and started to play legitimately. I now really want to get back and play Avicus again, so this is why I've come to appeal today. I believe I have served my time, and should be unbanned. Thank you :)
